# Obsidian Vaults

Obsidian notes are Markdown files with wikilinks, aliases, tags, folders, and YAML frontmatter.

The local index parses [[rag|RAG]] links and backlinks so an agent can retrieve nearby notes without reading every Markdown file.

```md
#not-a-real-tag
[[not-a-real-link]]
```

#real-tag
